summary: The recorded base reproduces shared Mooncake SSD directories. The exact candidate propagates scheduler DP identity into the registered direct linker and includes attention CP identity in the final directory, resolving both prior-review counterexamples and the original SGLang per-client directory-isolation contract.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual MooncakeStore setup path selection with a deterministic fake Mooncake client: pure-DP and attention-CP pairs collided, and only 1 of 16 DP/TP/PP/CP combinations was unique.
Candidate regression: 5 tests passed, covering direct-linker rank propagation, pure DP, attention CP, TP/PP, non-CP naming, directory creation, and an unconfigured path.
Independent adversarial topology probe: pure-DP and attention-CP pairs were distinct and all 16 combinations in a 2x2x2x2 DP/TP/PP/CP Cartesian topology had unique final directories.
Broader registered Mooncake unit coverage: 23 tests passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: The prepared environment exposed one AMD Instinct MI350X under torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2/HIP 7.2. The reviewed defect is deterministic Python rank propagation and filesystem path selection, so no GPU execution was used as evidence.

remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash weights and the reported TP8 or multi-node deployment were unavailable.
No live Mooncake LOCAL_DISK bucket-collision or restart-recovery workload was executed; validation exercised the actual SGLang path-selection source with a deterministic fake Mooncake client.
The Mooncake-side recovery and ownership implementation is outside this repository.
No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate changes only Python, documentation, tests, and report artifacts.
